(1st anniv) 11.15am john & elizabeth coffey & ann & tommy nolan, l/o strand street & longford. 12.30pm anthony pilarczyk o’sullivan, l/o lahern. next week’s mass intentions october 19th— 25th introduction to the readings this weekend first reading the lord guides all events for the good of his people so t hat they may be a blessing to others. even the coming to power of a new leader in a conquering nation is embraced by god’s providence. second reading this is the beginning of the very earliest christian writing. it sets out the themes that guide christian living, grace, peace, faith, love and hope. gospel the pharisees set out to trap jesus with a question, but he turns the tables on them. those who approach jesus without sincerity are blind to the truth. our lady and st brendan's

our parish mission statement in our parish people are nourished by the word of god. it is a parish where love is tangible and practical. it is a place where people pray together. our parish co mmunity is centred on jesus christ, on knowing and loving him. it is incarnated in the love we show o ne another. fr kieran o’brien ( 064) 7761669 /
